PR adds the two image denoising models from our Mobile AI 2026 Image Denoising Challenge submission, accepted at CVPRW 2026.

## Models

| File | Params | Val PSNR | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LiteDenoiseNet.py` | 1.96M | 37.66 dB | NPU-friendly student; deployable on Snapdragon 8 Elite (46.1 ms) and Dimensity 9500 (34.0 ms) at Full HD |
| `HeavyDenoiseNet.py` | 41.6M | 37.71 dB | U-Net-style teacher used for knowledge distillation |

The lightweight student recovers 99.8% of the teacher's restoration quality with a 21.2× parameter reduction.

## Supporting files

- **`ab/nn/loader/denoise.py`** — Augmented loader with 2-pixel buffer crops, geometric augmentations (horizontal/vertical flips, 90/180/270 degree rotations), and separate validation cropping. Replaces the previous simpler version.
- **`ab/nn/transform/denoise.py`** — Tensor conversion; removed `Resize(512,512)` since the loader now handles cropping directly.

## Stats

Includes 300-epoch training statistics for both models.
